story.fullStory:
Xtc's "Wonderland 1983" — original release 1983. "Wonderland" is a single by XTC released in June 1983, written by Colin Moulding and taken from the album Mummer.

Artist: XTC · Title: Wonderland (1983) · Year: 1983 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/XTC - Wonderland (1983).mp4.

Unlike most of XTC's work - which usually features a more guitar-oriented sound - "Wonderland" is heavily laden with synthesizer textures, most of which came from a Prophet-5 (the band's main synthesizer at the time).

This was the only single issued in the U.S.

approvedFacts.text: Artist: XTC · Title: Wonderland (1983) · Year: 1983 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1980's/XTC - Wonderland (1983).mp4
"Wonderland" is a single by XTC released in June 1983, written by Colin Moulding and taken from the album Mummer.

Unlike most of XTC's work - which usually features a more guitar-oriented sound - "Wonderland" is heavily laden with synthesizer textures, most of which came from a Prophet-5 (the band's main synthesizer at the time).
This was the only single issued in the U.S.
XTC released 12 original albums and over 30 singles for Virgin Records, between 1977 and 1992.
They signed to Cooking Vinyl for their final two albums in 1999 and 2000.
